Native limn author lookup/date controls, loading/error/retry/close, Escape, source banner, current-ID scroll/highlight and return-to-recent even after all context rows disappear.

regressions_red_green: Stale context overwrote content/pinned patch without edited timestamp: RED -> dirty rejection before persistence.
16 cached replies plus provider quota starved local answer: RED -> bounded optional-preview drain.
Unavailable local result was erased by polling: RED -> terminal result and immediate scheduling.
Network loss invalidated local continuation without data mutation: RED -> separate local namespace epoch.
State context8, SQLite6, worker6 and model4 directed cases.
Session queued reconnect/revocation/removal, neighboring delete/update/create and stale proof cases RED -> GREEN.
UI read-permission reopen, failed-context exit, known/exact author reachability, scope banner, empty context return, dialog cancellation and latest indicator RED -> GREEN.
